Group rides in Arizona

76 recurring group rides around Arizona: 48 road, 20 social, 13 mountain bike. 34 roll on weeknights, 41 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Friday Social Ride (regular and casual) in Cottonwood — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? The Shootout runs a 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph.
